open.intake-summary: User wants to replace local heavy models (ASR, voiceprint, emotion, pronunciation) with model API calls instead of running them locally.

design.design-summary: Design finalized: replace local ASR and speaker embedding with a single Model API Gateway; keep emotion/pronunciation local for now because local prosody/pinyin already provide sufficient baseline value. Artifacts generated: docs/superpowers/specs/api-model-integration-design.md, docs/superpowers/specs/api-model-integration-architecture.html (showcase), openspec/changes/api-model-integration/specs/api-model-integration/spec.md.
design.user-confirmation: User confirmed after plain-language explanation of why only ASR and embedding are API-ized and why emotion/pronunciation stay local.

plan.producer-summary: Created implementation plan at docs/superpowers/plans/api-model-integration-plan.md and task contract at openspec/changes/api-model-integration/tasks.md. Plan covers ModelAPIClient, config extension, transcriber/embeddings refactoring, tests, end-to-end validation, and README updates.

execute.implementation-summary: 完成模型 API Gateway 集成：新增 src/model_api_client.py 统一客户端；改造 src/transcriber.py 与 src/embeddings.py 优先调用 API，失败回退本地；更新 config.yaml、requirements.txt、README.md 与测试；情感和正音保持本地并预留 API 接口
execute.test-evidence: pytest tests/ 全部 39 项通过

archive.archive-summary: 将 api-model-integration 变更归档：更新 openspec/design.md 与 delta spec 验收状态，标记 .comet.yaml archived: true
